_note: cal-1 model choices, frozen before the first calibration run (2026-11-01). Only the three factors under 'factors' are calibrated.

f_kd.meaning: multiplier on jet-test kd (cohesive, Hanson law)

cohesive.cohesion: qu/2 when unconfined strength qu is reported (G1); else source value

hydraulics.manning_n: case source value; lab cases without one: max(0.016, Strickler D50^(1/6)/21.1)

grid.dx_dy: H/8 for lab cases, H/6 for field cases
grid.transverse_width: lab: test-section or flume width; field: crest length if given, else 12 H

boundaries.upstream: 0-D reservoir from the case stage-volume or area-height data
boundaries.downstream: outfall (free overfall); closed flumes: wall with the flume length downstream

start: reservoir at the notch invert (overtopping starts at t = 0) unless the source gives the level at breach
end: stop 600 s after the lake is drained, or at the case t_end; steady-inflow no-breach cases: morph_accel 10 over the test duration

outputs.Tp: time of that peak from t = 0
outputs.B: final breach width, crest rows, columns lowered >= 50 % of max
outputs.breached: notch invert lowered by > 50 % of the notch depth
